verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents Klaviyo-maintained SDKs for server-side languages (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter). A dedicated SDK overview page details mobile capabilities such as profile identification, event tracking, push and geofencing. An importable OpenAPI spec and Klaviyo Labs reference code on GitHub add to the developer building surface. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and documented depth of server SDK coverage (endpoint parity, versioning)
